heading: Things I've actually built
intro: Autonomous hardware, full-stack applications and data tooling, built solo or leading small teams.

projects.title: ORCA Surfer
projects.subtitle: Autonomous marine litter collector
projects.description: An IoT-enabled boat that finds and collects floating waste on its own. I built the YOLOv5 detection pipeline and the sensor-navigation stack that maps debris in real time and steers the craft toward it. Presented at OSICON 2025, CSIR-NIO, Goa.

projects.title: Autonomous Surface Vehicle
projects.subtitle: Navigation and electronics for an ocean-going vehicle
projects.description: GNSS-IMU sensor fusion for positioning and heading, a LoRa telemetry link to the shore station, and artificial-potential-field obstacle avoidance simulated in ROS and Gazebo.

projects.title: Aqua Nexus
projects.subtitle: Flood monitoring platform
projects.description: A web and mobile application for real-time river water-level monitoring, backed by PostgreSQL with PostGIS. Includes GPS-tagged field reporting, image watermarking for verifiable evidence, and a live dashboard for local authorities.

projects.title: Argo Float Data Pipeline
projects.subtitle: Oceanographic analysis, automated
projects.description: Python tooling that ingests Argo float oceanographic datasets and automates extraction, cleaning and visualization of temperature and salinity profiles, replacing analysis that was previously done by hand.

projects.title: River Water Quality Monitor
projects.subtitle: Live sensing with automatic alerts
projects.description: An IoT monitoring system reading pH, turbidity and conductivity, streaming into a Flask dashboard that fires automatic alerts the moment any reading crosses a safe threshold.

projects.title: Computer Vision Prediction System
projects.subtitle: Research team lead
projects.description: Led a research team building a body-constitution prediction system from images using OpenCV, benchmarking SVM, Random Forest and CNN approaches, and contributing to a paper draft on AI-based environmental sensing.
